'''Dagbats''', also known as '''Dagles'''<ref name="Instructions">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' Instruction Booklet (THQ)</ref>, were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of winged creatures native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="SEMP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dagbats were first seen in 1991's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1991 video game)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' video game]], and named in the game's manual.<ref name="NES Instructions">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' Instruction Booklet (JVC)</ref> A different, more elaborate version of the creature was seen in ''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''. That game's manual called it a "Dagle", but a [[Super Empire Strikes Back Official Game Secrets|guide]] to that game used "Dagbat" again.
